info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get Consumer Service By Param1-spec
info.description: The Consumer Advisory Services Retrieval API allows users to access specific consumer advisory services based on the provided parameters. This API is designed for financial institutions and advisory firms that need to retrieve detailed information about advisory services offered to consumers. By providing a unique identifier as a parameter, businesses can quickly obtain the relevant data to assist their clients in making informed decisions. Typical consumers of this API include banking applications and consumer service platforms seeking to enhance their service offerings.

get.summary: Retrieve a specific consumer advisory service.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch detailed information about a specific consumer advisory service identified by its unique ID. Utilize this service to access relevant data and insights to assist consumers effectively.
